Author: dajoey
Name: PvP Solver
Description: PvP-only auto-rotation for FFXIV. Activates in PvP zones.
Changelog: Synced upstream RotationSolverReborn 2ac940563: the EmergencyGCD hook now receives the queued next GCD, matching EmergencyAbility and the other rotation hooks. No gameplay change - the new parameter is unread by every implementation of the hook, upstream and in this fork. Purify, Guard, Recuperate, Standard-issue Elixir, WHM Aquaveil and BRD Warden's Paean behaviour are unchanged. WHM and BRD PvP rotations are now byte-identical to upstream 641bd792e.
